Subject: Quick follow-up — missed technical demo / compact hands-on offer

Hi Sarah,

We had scheduled a technical walkthrough for Finora earlier today but saw you weren’t able to join. I hope everything’s okay — no worries if something came up. Two quick options to get momentum back:

1) Live compact lab (30–40 min): focused, hands-on run-through with SE + product PM (we’ll keep it tightly scoped).
2) Async sandbox-first path: we drop temporary sandbox credentials and a 15-min checklist so your team can poke around; we follow up with a short sync to go over findings.

Proposed live windows (all PT):
- Wed 2026-12-16 10:00–10:40
- Thu 2026-12-17 11:00–11:40
- Fri 2026-12-18 08:30–09:10

Compact agenda (live lab):
- 5m: goals & success criteria (your top 2 priorities)
- 15m: hands-on run through with a sample dataset in the sandbox
- 10m: security/data handling Qs + PM discussion on pilot scope
- 10m: next steps / pilot kickoff checklist

I’m looping Marissa (SE) and Rishi (PM) so we can coordinate the hands-on bits. Attached is a lite-poc checklist and temporary sandbox credentials in case you prefer the async route. If another time works better, share a couple windows and we’ll make it work.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Jordan — thanks for the ping. I’ll be on any of those slots and can run the hands-on portion. Quick notes for the sandbox:

If Sarah heads async, I’ll publish a short runbook in the Drive link you shared and include expected runtime/cost for the sample tests.
